scientific_integrity: An analytic proof is supplied, together with a standalone rational checker; finite tests are corroboration, not proof. No authorship or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected positive-weight graphs, real-valued data, Euclidean squared-fidelity graph anisotropic TV prox at every fixed positive lambda; the finite partition/cut maximum need not admit efficient evaluation. Quadratic amplification order is shown for barbells, not an exact maximum over all n-vertex graphs. Historical priority may have implicit antecedents.
title: Exact graph-variation perturbation modulus of the graph fused-lasso denoiser
